episodes.210301: A cold front moved down the island chain, bringing strong north to northeast winds in its wake. These strong winds brought numerous impacts to the state. Heavy rain also led to landslides and road closures on the Big Island.

events.narrative: Law Enforcement reported landslides in Laupahoehoe Gulch, Kawaili Gulch, and Maulua Gulch.
Hawaii County Civil Defense reported landslides along Waipio Valley Access Rd. The road was shut down as a result.
